text: Old-school fragmentation grenades strapped to a belt. They can be thrown a short distance, where they'll explode, damaging anything and anyone nearby. Can be reloaded using frag grenades.

Glass bottles filled with flammable liquid, with a burning cloth in the neck, strapped to a belt. A favorite weapon of hooligans and desperate warriors from rim to rim. They can be thrown a short distance, where they'll explode, damaging anything and anyone nearby, setting chemfuel on fire. Can be reloaded using molotovs.
Electromagnetic pulse grenades damaging to electronic equipment strapped to a belt. They can be thrown a short distance, where they'll explode, disabling any electronics for a brief duration.
